items.q: What is GTC Financial Consultancy licensed to do?
items.a: GTC Financial Consultancy L.L.C is licensed by the UAE Capital Market Authority under Category 5 (Licence No. 20200000211) to provide financial consultation, introduction and promotion services. It does not hold client money, does not carry out transactions on behalf of clients and does not open client accounts.

Individuals and businesses in the UAE who would like general information about financial products and services, or an introduction to a licensed provider. Any eligibility or client classification is assessed by the provider you are introduced to.

items.q: How is my personal data used?
items.a: Your data is collected with your consent, used only to respond to your enquiry and handled in line with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law and our Privacy Policy. We do not sell your data.

items.q: Do you provide personal investment advice?
items.a: No. Our consultations offer general guidance to help you understand financial products and services. We do not make personal recommendations, and any financial decision remains your own. Where necessary, please seek independent professional advice.

footer.title: Important information
footer.text: GTC Financial Consultancy L.L.C is licensed by the UAE Capital Market Authority (CMA) under Category 5 (Financial Consultations, Introduction and Promotion), Licence No. 20200000211.
